card.name: Small words opening a new subject
card.fires_on: Short linking words (for, in, is, are, were, 's) right after a contrast or transition like 'but' or 'meanwhile' in news-style prose. They come just before the sentence's real subject is named.

modes.description: 'for' or 'in' right after 'but', 'meanwhile' or 'yet' that introduces a contrasting group.
